model: GO3 Series horticulture CO2 sensor (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone GO3 series horticulture CO2 sensors (0-20,000 ppm) with optional temperature, RH and relay, using BACnet MS/TP.
summary: The GO3 is a Greystone CO2 sensor for grow rooms and greenhouses, with native BACnet MS/TP. CO2 and the optional temperature and RH readings are Analog Inputs; altitude, relay setpoint, hysteresis, delay and offsets are Analog Values, and the relay state is a Binary Input. Its device object name defaults to "CDD CO2 001".
notes: Points from the object table in section 1.1 of the setup guide.
The relay setpoint and hysteresis limits depend on the CO2 sensor fitted: auto-calibrating (up to 5000 ppm) or dual-beam (up to 15,000 ppm).
Temperature, RH and relay objects report a fault when those options are not installed; BV 2 only works with the auto-cal sensor.
Access from the object pages: AV and BV Present_Value are read/write.

source.title: GO3 Series Horticulture Sensor - Setup Guide BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, set altitude, then read CO2 (AI 1) and the optional temperature and RH. Use the relay status if the relay drives CO2 dosing or venting.
setup: Device instance defaults to 381001 (381000 + MAC 1); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
Max_Master defaults to 127 and is writable (1-127).
gotchas: Objects for options that are not fitted report Reliability NO_SENSOR and Event_State FAULT.

points.name: Relay Setpoint
points.description: CO2 relay trip point (default 1000 ppm); max 5000 auto-cal, 15,000 dual-beam

points.name: Relay Hysteresis
points.description: Relay hysteresis (default 50 ppm); max 200 auto-cal, 500 dual-beam
